claim.method: upstream extractor, length balancing and probe trainer at the pinned commit
claim.statement: We find that different LLMs represent these subtypes differently, with either more aligned or more distinct representations

provenance.resample_rule: value 0 keeps the paper's rows; value k>0 draws the records with replacement under random.Random(10000 + k)

beats_random.justification: Jaccard at least 0.20 above the exact pair-size-matched uniform-set expectation: the README's frozen minimum excess over chance

claim_stability.justification: population modal claim share at least 0.80 over the registered classes: the diagnostic profile's filability bar

specificity.justification: real minus null-control mean Jaccard at least 0.20: the README's frozen minimum real-minus-null difference

structural_stability.justification: mean Jaccard of disjoint IID run pairs at least 0.80: the same overlap bar the diagnostic profile registers, applied to independent specification draws instead of one-axis-at-a-time variants
